relations.description: If gapSharingFR1 is set to setup and configuration is already setup, release the configuration.
If gapSharingFR1 is set to setup, setup the FR1 measurement gap sharing configuration.
If gapSharingFR1 is set to release, release the FR1 measurement gap sharing configuration.
If gapSharingFR2 is set to setup and configuration is already setup, release the configuration.
If gapSharingFR2 is set to setup, setup the FR2 measurement gap sharing configuration.
If gapSharingFR2 is set to release, release the FR2 measurement gap sharing configuration.
If gapSharingUE is set to setup and configuration is already setup, release the configuration.
If gapSharingUE is set to setup, setup the per UE measurement gap sharing configuration.
If gapSharingUE is set to release, release the per UE measurement gap sharing configuration.
